source: the raw records of the runners of GitHub, judged again with the catalog after the calibration of the propagation

cells.name: iptables, callers learn that a pod cannot serve: endpoints only

prediction.text: The algebra predicts that each failed request starts in a window. The window opens at the fault, and it closes 0 s to 6.16 s after the end of the fault. At least one request fails. Each failed request ends with an answer of 503.

cells.why: Each of the 3 counted runs agrees with the prediction. The median run had 2,542 failed requests. The counted runs had 2,033 to 2,689 failed requests.
